categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily focuses on the research, development, production, and sales of hot melt adhesives specialized for absorbent hygiene products. Its products are mainly used in baby diapers, sanitary napkins, adult incontinence products, medical hygiene products, and pet hygiene products. The company also operates overseas subsidiaries involved in production and marketing of adhesive products.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced polymer materials technology to produce environmentally friendly hot melt pressure-sensitive adhesives. It employs automated and intelligent manufacturing processes including robotics, smart warehousing, AGV and RGV systems. The company holds 23 patents and continuously innovates in biodegradable and bio-based adhesive formulations, as well as automated production control systems.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include leading global hygiene product manufacturers such as Kimberly-Clark, Procter & Gamble, Drylock, Essity, Vinda, Daio Paper, and Hengan. The company serves the disposable hygiene products market including baby care, feminine hygiene, adult incontinence, medical, and pet care sectors. It has established supply relationships with top ten global hygiene product companies.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates production and R&D facilities in China (Guangzhou), Poland, Turkey, Singapore, and Malaysia, with sales covering domestic China and international markets including Europe, North America, Asia, Africa, and Latin America. Overseas markets account for over 58% of revenue, with ongoing expansion efforts in North America, Western Europe, and Asia.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream segment of the supply chain as a manufacturer and supplier of specialized hot melt adhesives used as key raw materials in disposable hygiene product manufacturing. It collaborates closely with upstream raw material suppliers and downstream hygiene product manufacturers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include expanding global production capacity, enhancing overseas market penetration, and maintaining technological leadership through continuous R&D innovation. Key R&D focuses are on developing green, low-VOC, biodegradable, bio-based adhesives, and functional adhesives with properties like antibacterial and low odor. The company also invests in automation and digitalization of production processes.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through direct sales of hot melt adhesive products to hygiene product manufacturers. The company employs a direct sales model supplemented by trade sales and provides technical services to customers. Revenue is recognized upon delivery and customer acceptance of products.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is one of the four major suppliers in the domestic hot melt adhesive market for hygiene products, successfully replacing imports and competing with international giants such as Henkel, H.B. Fuller, and Bostik. It holds a leading position domestically and is expanding its presence internationally, though its overseas market share remains relatively small compared to these global competitors.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company achieved operating revenue of approximately RMB 2.006 billion, a 23.27% increase year-over-year. Net profit attributable to shareholders was RMB 78.16 million, a decrease of 27.7% due to increased raw material costs and investments in overseas expansion. The company’s total assets reached RMB 1.928 billion, with ongoing investments in new production facilities and R&D centers supporting growth.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes environmentally friendly, solvent-free, non-toxic hot melt adhesives tailored for high-performance hygiene products. Its competitive advantages include advanced proprietary formulations, strong R&D capabilities, customized technical services, and a global supply chain footprint. The company focuses on product innovation to meet diverse and evolving customer needs, including biodegradable and bio-based adhesives, enhancing sustainability and compliance with stringent international standards.
